linux_x86_control.device: Fanxiang X6 / ASMedia ASM2464PD with Crucial P310 4 TB
linux_x86_control.connection: direct to the ThinkPad Thunderbolt 3 port with the known USB4 cable
linux_x86_control.usb4_link: 40 Gbit/s, 2 x 20 Gbit/s in both directions

conclusion: The reproducible failure follows the Apple M1 software-managed USB4 path with the ASMedia ASM246x family across two enclosure brands, both Mac ports and the known USB4 cable. The same Fanxiang ASM2464PD enclosure, cable and Crucial NVMe are stable when connected directly to the Intel JHL6240 Thunderbolt 3 host in a ThinkPad T480, so the enclosure, SSD and Belkin dock are excluded as the primary cause. Legacy Intel Thunderbolt 3 also remains stable on the Apple ACIO/NHI stack. The remaining focus is Apple ACIO/NHI PCIe-tunnel setup, DART mapping and interrupt integration for the ASM246x path.
next_focus: control test with a native USB4 device using non-ASMedia silicon
